result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers meet every rubric item. Each sets body text to 17–18px with 1.55–1.6 line-height, caps the measure at a readable width (68ch vs 46rem), raises .note to 14px, leaves the colors and HTML alone, keeps a clear heading hierarchy with tighter heading leading, and uses 1em paragraph spacing. B adds rem units and text-wrap refinements, while A gives a concrete darker gray as a contrast fix; neither is clearly better overall. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers meet every rubric item. A uses 17px/1.55 with a 46rem centered column; B uses 18px/1.6 with a 68ch column. Both raise .note to 14px, keep the colors and HTML unchanged, preserve a clear heading order, and point out the #777 contrast problem. A adds text-wrap balance/pretty and rem units, and B explains its changes a bit more, but neither difference is big enough to choose one over the other.
